MANDATORY on this origin; the default /./ harvests all 426 and many die on the ibm-products Storybook's own chromatic/isChromatic module error, which sends 100+ dead stories to a sequential retry the run never finishes.
_meta.versionNote: This origin has no single "Carbon version" and carbonVersion is therefore NOT written -- the same decision carbon-react-*.json made when it replaced that field with named ones. @carbon/ibm-products 2.97.0 is the release the Storybook welcome page names; the rest are READ FROM /project.json on the same origin (knownPackages.uiLibraryPackages), not assumed. They are RANGES, because that is what ibm-products declares -- the cds-- classes here are attributable only to a range, never to one @carbon/react build. Note carbonStyles ^1.110.1 is BELOW the 1.114.0 this repo compiles, so a cds-- divergence between these captures and carbon-react-*.json (which record 1.115.0 / 1.114.0) can be Carbon moving rather than a fault here.
_meta.settle: THESE STORIES PAINT RIGHT AT THE EXTRACTOR SETTLE CEILING. Measured 2026-08-31, one iframe at a time and unhurried: components-sidepanel--slide-over first paints a classed element at 4.4s, preview-pageheader--default at 6.0s. SETTLE_MAX_MS is 6000 and CONCURRENCY is 3, so a first pass files ALL of them (empty) -- 21/21 on this capture -- and it is the sequential retry at SETTLE_MAX_MS*2 that recovers them (20/21 here; the last was re-harvested alone with FILTER narrowed to it). An (empty) on this origin is therefore a TIMING result and not the chromatic/isChromatic module error, which is a different fault and hits the stories the FILTER already excludes. Do not read a first-pass (empty) here as a broken story.
